about_the_game:
A multiplayer raccoon adventure about exploring the city and taking on strange jobs from your crew.

Play solo or with up to 3 friends online as a group of raccoons completing missions across the city.

Climb, explore, and find your own way through each location. Between expeditions, return to the treehouse and prepare for the next job.

Meet the crew

Garry – organizes the crew and keeps track of missions.
Randy – the builder behind the treehouse and new structures.
Billy – runs the shop and trades useful items with the crew.
Pip & Flip – a chaotic duo who somehow keep getting everyone into trouble.

Expeditions across the city

Each expedition takes place in a different location.

Sneak into the Pizzeria after closing time, climb scaffolding at the Construction Site, or race through the Train Station before the train leaves.

Levels are designed for climbing and exploration. Rooftops, vents, pipes, cranes, and trash piles can all become part of your route.

Online mini-games

Take a break from expeditions and jump into quick multiplayer matches.

Snack Hunt
Collect as many snacks as possible before time runs out.

Dumpster League
A raccoon take on a familiar ball sport.

Runmageddon
Reach the finish line while avoiding obstacles.

More mini-games appear as the raccoon crew comes up with new ideas.

Build your treehouse

Between expeditions you return to your raccoon base.

Expand the treehouse with new structures, decorations, and collectibles discovered during missions. Over time it becomes a home for the entire raccoon crew.

Customize your raccoon

Unlock hats, accessories, and other cosmetics during expeditions and mini-games.

Mix and match outfits to give your raccoon its own look.

Features

  • Play solo or with up to 3 friends online

  • Story missions across various locations

  • Multiplayer mini-games including Snack Hunt, Dumpster League, and Runmageddon

  • Levels designed for climbing and exploration

  • Expandable treehouse base

  • Unlockable hats and cosmetics

  • A crew of raccoon characters including Garry, Randy, Billy, Pip & Flip

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i3-4160 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 360
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel i5-9400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD RX 560
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Play as a raccoon completing missions, climbing through interactive levels, and expanding your treehouse base. Explore, experiment, and play mini-games solo or with up to 3 friends online.
